title: 1958 AHSME Problem 26
statement: A set of \(n\) numbers has the sum \(s.\) Each number of the set is increased by \(20,\) then multiplied by \(5,\) and then decreased by \(20.\) The sum of the numbers in the new set thus obtained is:

solutions.text:
An original number \(u\) becomes \[ 5(u+20)-20=5u+80. \] Summing over the \(n\) original numbers therefore gives \[ 5s+80n. \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Apply all three operations to a typical original number \(u\)
After simplifying the transformed number, sum over all \(n\) entries
